profile.headline: Software Engineer at Softlayer, an IBM Company
profile.summary:
A technical professional with fifteen years of professional experience in the IT industry. Committed to providing system administration support that meets the highest quality standards and requirements. An effective problem solver with the ability to research and analyze situations to propose proactive and creative solutions. Detail-oriented with strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills.

Specialties: - HP-UX Systems – Superdomes, RP8400, RP7410, RP3440, RP4440, N-Class, V-Class, K-Class
- HP-UX Operating Systems – 11.00, 11.11, 11.23, 11.31
- Linux Operating Systems – RedHat (RHEL 5 & RHEL 6), CentOS, SUSE
- LVM, VERITAS Volume Manager (VxVm), Powerpath, EVA Disk Arrays, EMC Disk Arrays, MC Service Guard
- SQL*Plus, C, Shell scripting (expect, tcsh, Tcl/TK, awk, sh, csh)
- VMware Administration
- Government Security Clearance: 6C

positions.title: Senior Unix System Administrator Advisor - Corelogic Account
positions.description:
•	Provided technical system support for production and non-production environments for the Corelogic account on physical and virtual Linux servers.
•	Duties include, but not limited to server build-outs, administration of users, managing 3rd party software, maintain security standards on all servers, technical recovery documentation, and coordination with enterprise wide application and team members to maintain high availability of the environments to meet company standards.
•	Perform task to migrate physical Linux servers to virtual Linux servers using VMware
•	Perform task in migrating the various UNIX platforms over to the Linux platform as part of the UNIX to Linux project (U2L).
•	Perform work with team members in providing system support to transitioning servers from the old data centers to the new data centers as part the data center migration project.
•	Provided proactive and reactive support and resolution of hardware/software issues to maintain minimal service disruptions.
•	Implement hardware/software upgrades.
•	Provided 7x24 on-call support coverage on a rotating basis.

positions.title: Senior Unix System Administrator Advisor - Federal Student Aid (FSA) Account
positions.description:
•	Provided technical system support for production and non-production environments of the Federal Student Aid application for Government Services on physical and virtual Linux servers.
•	Duties include, but not limited to Linux (RHEL 5 & CentOS) and HP-UX server build-outs, administration of users, managing 3rd party software, maintain security standards on all servers, technical recovery documentation, and coordination with enterprise wide application and team members to maintain high availability of the environments to meet company standards.
•	Build systems, install and configure MC Service Guard on HP-UX, oracle grid on Linux, and other 3rd party software according to the specifications.
•	Perform task to migrate physical Linux servers to virtual Linux servers using VMware.
•	Provided proactive and reactive support and resolution of hardware/software issues to maintain minimal service disruptions.
•	Implement hardware/software upgrades.
•	Provided 7x24 on-call support coverage on a rotating basis.
•	Perform tasks in recovering physical and virtual Linux servers in the Disaster Recovery Exercise.
•	Kernel tuning to optimize system performance.
•	Project Lead to implement the oracle grid as part of the database expansion on HP-UX servers and work with team members to implement database expansion of the oracle grid on Linux servers.
•	Perform duties in testing, validating, and documenting OS system recovery for Linux servers using TBMR (Cristie).

positions.title: System Administrator I
positions.description:
• Provided system support for production and non-production environments of the Telegence customer billing and report applications on HP-UX servers.
• Duties include, but not limited to server build-outs, administration of users, managing 3rd party software, maintain SOX security standards on all servers, technical recovery documentation, and coordination with enterprise wipe application and team members to maintain high availability of the environments to meet company standards.
• Build systems, install and configure 3rd party software according to specifications.
• Provided proactive and reactive support and resolution of hardware/software issues to maintain minimal service disruptions.
• Implement hardware/software upgrades.
• Provided 7x24 on-call support coverage on a rotating basis.
• Perform SOX system security audits to maintain system security and integrity.
• Kernel tuning to optimize system performance.
• File system management

positions.title: Analysts
positions.description:
• Perform an analysis to solve technical problems within the Telegence Billing application running on HP-UX servers.
• Designed and developed GUIs using Tcl/TK to automate manual processes used in production, and quality assurance group.
• Enhance and maintain existing GUIs used in the production and non-production environment by the various Telegence wireless group to meet the business needs.
• Performed duties by integrating and implementing new markets systems and assisting with the resolution of problems associated with the new markets.
• Provide support for the production, implementation, and development and quality assurance groups via both ticket escalation and verbal communication.
• Develop scripts using SQL*Plus to execute jobs to retrieve data from the oracle database.
• Performed duties in user account profile setup and system security through compliance with security guidelines.
• Performed 7x24 on-call support coverage on a rotating basis which consists of technical support for various Telegence and quality assurance groups and assist with day-to-day technical issues to maintain high availability of the environments
